definitions.full: H3171. Yechiel or Yechavel יחואל proper name, masculine 2Chr 29:14 Kt; Qr יְחִיאֵל q. v. below חיה . II. חוה (√ of following; Arabic collect, gather ; circle of tents compare II. חַי below חיה , Arabic ). יְחִיאֵל proper name, masculine ( may El live ; Phoenician יחומלך יחואלן, see Eut ZMG 1876, 136 ) — ᵐ5 usually Ιειηλ, Ιαιηλ ; — 1 one of David's chief musicians 1Chr 15:18 ( ᵐ5 Ιειηλ , ᵐ5 L Ιαιηλ ), 15:20 ( ᵐ5 Ειθηλ , ᵐ5 L Ιειηλ ), 16:5 ( ᵐ5 Ειειηλ , ᵐ5 L Ιαιηλ ). 2 one of David's chiefs of the Levites 1Chr 23:8 ( ᵐ5 Ι ( ει ) ηλ ), 29:8 ( ᵐ5 Βεσιηλ , A ᵐ5 L Ιειηλ ). 3 tutor of David's sons 1Chr 27:32 ( ᵐ5 Ιε ( ρι ) ηλ , ᵐ5 L Ιωηλ ). 4 son of Jehoshaphat 2Chr 21:2 . 5 יְחִו֯אֵל Hemanite of Hezekiah's reign 2Chr 29:14 . 6 over-seer in Hezekiah's reign 2Chr 31:13 . 7 ruler of the temple in Josiah's reign 2Chr 35:8 . 8 contemporaries of Ezra , Ezra 8:9 ( ᵐ5 Ιεμα A Ιεειηλ , ᵐ5 L Ιειηλ ), 10:2 , 21 , 6 .
